Dill, as a Christian name, may have also been influenced by the biblical figure Dila, the daughter of King Abitamini of Edom mentioned in Genesis 36:33. Dila's name means "delicate" or "slow", however, her great loyalty to her father and her people despite their idolatrous practices, may have added to the association of the name Dill with strength and reliability.
